text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the appointed candidate are women, so sex was not a deciding factor in the hiring decision. An all-female selection panel is coincidental or reflective of the internal team; it is not evidence of discrimination against female candidates. 

For a senior leadership role like head of risk modelling, institutions frequently prioritize direct regulatory affairs experience and commercial banking knowledge alongside technical depth. Raising gender bias when another woman was selected is factually unsupportable and could damage your professional reputation in a specialized market. 

Two weeks is a routine delay for corporate HR. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused strictly on skills, regulatory exposure, and interview performance.
